name: quilhara
title: Quilhara showcase
description: A finished bilingual sample site for a fictional trail magazine and guided-trip outfitter: home, trail, story, guide and trip pages in English and Brazilian Portuguese, with a designed theme, self-hosted fonts and its own photography. Apply it to a new site to see what Viglet Shio renders.

pt-BR.title: Vitrine Quilhara
pt-BR.description: Um site de exemplo pronto e bilíngue para uma revista de trilhas e uma agência de viagens guiadas fictícias: páginas de início, trilha, história, guia e viagem em português e inglês, com tema desenhado, fontes próprias e fotografia original. Aplique em um site novo para ver o que o Viglet Shio desenha.

assets.alt: Two hikers on a narrow grassy path along a cliff above a turquoise bay in early light.
A rocky ridge trail with a stone cairn above a sea of morning clouds.
A trail across dark coastal rocks with tide pools and a wooden waymark post.
A dirt path through dense green forest with ferns, beside a small waterfall and pool.
Hands holding a printed tide table and a pencil over a barnacled rock on a wet beach.
Three volunteers in work gloves rebuilding stone steps on a forest trail.
A woman in a field shirt and cap standing on a grassy headland above the sea.
Small tents on a grassy saddle between peaks at dusk, hikers eating by headlamp.
A worn topographic map, a compass, a pencil and a notebook on a wooden table.
A small wooden hut with a covered porch and two bicycles at the edge of a coastal village.
